rules.ambiguous: A normalised name shared by two players maps to NOTHING. A wrong player is worse than a missing one, because nothing about a wrong number looks wrong.
rules.not_a_migration: Layers keep their own keys. This is the join, not a re-key - player_metrics_2025 is frozen and App.jsx is name-keyed, and neither is touched.
rules.scope: last_season >= min_last_season. Retired players are excluded because each one is another chance to collide with an active one.
